notes.title: Keybinding is Here! Demo Version 0.5 is Live!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This update brings highly requested features and a number of improvements based on your feedback.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]Keybinding for keyboard controls has been implemented.[/b] You can now customize your key layout to your liking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overall image quality has been improved[/b] when using the FSR upscaling option.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Dragon Dodge[/b] key has been reassigned to [b]ALT[/b] on the keyboard and the [b]X button[/b] on controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]The parry animation has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bugs and issues have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]We appreciate all your feedback and support. Please continue to share your thoughts with us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Responsiveness Issue Resolved!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png"][/img][/p][p]Great news, everyone! We've successfully addressed the responsiveness and clunky feeling some players experienced with the [b]Drair[/b] and [b]Dragon[/b] controls on certain devices.[/p][p]We've completely overhauled the input system, and we're confident you'll love the new, snappier response across [b]all controls[/b], especially when accelerating and turning. Get ready for a much smoother and more precise gameplay experience![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version! Melee Combat Improved, New Ship Furnishings, and Many Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Demo Version 0.42 Now Live![/b][/p][p]We've just released a hotfix with some important improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Melee combat AI behaviors improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee combat animations improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Melee combat block system improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bugs that occurred at the beginning of the Dragon fire.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where birds couldn't be caught in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of birds to be hunted in the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]The Captain's Cabin in the Ship Hub has been revamped![/p][/*][*][p]Melee combat roll is now more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation smoothing improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Dragon tackle fixes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Languages, Dragon Mechanics & Combat Improvements!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello, Dragon Riders![/b][/p][p]We're excited to push a major new update live, packed with features you've been asking for and significant quality-of-life improvements. Thank you for your continued support and feedback![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in version 0.35:[/p][p][b]Localization[/b][/p][list][*][p]We're going global! We have added full text support for five new languages:[/p][list][*][p][b]French[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]German[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Russian[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spanish[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Turkish[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]New Dragon Mechanics[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Aerial Mount Rescue:[/b] You can now summon your dragon while falling to perform a heroic mid-air mount and avoid fall damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Land Anywhere:[/b] Your dragon can now land seamlessly in almost any viable location, giving you unprecedented freedom to explore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summon from Anywhere:[/b] You no longer need to be at specific locations to call your companion. You can now summon your dragon to you from almost anywhere on the ground.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Combat & UI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Firearm Overhaul:[/b] We've improved the crosshairs on firearms for better targeting and added a [b]headshot damage multiplier[/b] to reward precision shots.[/p][/*][*][p][b]HUD Redesign:[/b] Key elements of the main HUD (Heads-Up Display) have been improved for a cleaner, more intuitive user experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes & Stability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a multitude of bugs and crashes reported by the community.[/p][/*][*][p]General performance enhancements to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]We believe these changes will make your adventures even more epic. As always, please continue to share your feedback with us on our Steam forums and Discord.[/p][p]
Aer's wind guide your wings! [i]- The Elos Team[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.2 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/0cd568a74fad833388cac52ee14b0b1a926f59c4.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

We've just released a hotfix to address some of the issues you've reported. Thank you for your valuable feedback!

Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when blowing things up with the dragon in camps.
[*] Resolved several bugs that were affecting the quest flow.
[*] Fixed bugs within the Blacksmith's trade menu.
[*] Improved keyboard control prompts in the tutorial.
[*] The tackle sequence in the tutorial has been made easier.
[*] Increased the number of edible birds in the tutorial.
[*] Remapped the Dragon Dodge key to 'V' for keyboard controls.
[*] Fixed an issue where the dragon would appear overly low-poly on certain graphics settings.
[*] Made general performance improvements.
[/list]

We will continue to monitor your feedback and work on further improvements. Thank you for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png[/img]

notes.title: Dragons and Floating Islands?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/e9b564b7db445c90d9099f1b80687874163ddcba.png[/img]
[h3][b]Morally Grey Stories[/b][/h3]
  Lumin offers a world that goes far beyond floating islands and dragons. Here, things aren’t just black and white; you’ll be the one to draw the lines between good and evil. The decisions you make will shape not only your character but also your experiences and growth within the game. With each step you take to uncover the story, you’ll discover more about yourself and determine how your journey unfolds.
In the end, the good don’t always win… Is ‘good’ merely a compass, or is it a map that leads in different directions for each hand that holds it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/531f3908a09ffa2f7a0ff47af96f723c8aeabd7b.png[/img]
[h3][b]Lumin Rising with Your Ideas[/b][/h3]
  At Elos Games & Arts, our mission is to grow and evolve alongside you, our valued community! Your feedback during the game development process is invaluable to us. The insights you share help shape the direction of Lumin and play a significant role in the evolution of this incredible world. Our Steam community is at the heart of Lumin; here, you can share your ideas, make suggestions, and have a say in the future of the game. Together, we’re excitedly expanding the Lumin universe every day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/494133156a20af171322808f4428d372c714365a.png[/img]
[h3][b]Creating Together: Unity of Team and Community[/b][/h3]
  Lumin is more than just a game; it represents a collaborative creative process. We’re a passionate and creative team working in an open-minded, fun environment, and this energy is reflected in our in-game experiences. We love engaging in idea exchanges and sharing with our community on this journey, where players are an integral part of the process. Just as every voice in our team is important, the voice of our community holds immense value for us as well. Together, we’re having fun, learning, and creating!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/838c016dad9736da2526805684421f2f4a034610.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188620/563b697ec3558e89b0e22c235ac883230996c346.png[/img]
